    Oh Canada! Celebrate with Fresh Air & Polar Bears, our newest candle in collaboration with talented Kal Barteski, with a portion of the proceeds going to the Polar Bear Fund. This candle features a trio of clover, jasmine, and aloe.
     
    Burn time is approx. 50  - 60 hours and features an FSC crackling wooden wick.
